app.title: Whip Clothing Tool
app.subtitle: Export GTA V clothing previews and prop models for FiveM (WHIP).

paths.gtavLegacyHint: Required for vanilla extraction (folder containing GTA5.exe and update/x64).
paths.addonFoldersHint: One or more folders containing .ydd/.ytd files (e.g. resources/[clothing]/...).
paths.outputRootHint: One folder for everything. The tool creates subfolders automatically: models/ and previews/.

previews.title: Preview images
previews.sizeHint: Square output, e.g. 256 or 512. Same fixed angle and lighting for all items.
previews.transparentNote: Transparent background when the format supports it (PNG/WebP). JPEG does not support transparency.
previews.note: All drawable and texture variants are exported automatically.

models.title: Prop models
models.note: Exports all drawable and texture variants as .ydr + .ytd. Model names are generated automatically from the source clothing file name.

categories.hint: Select one or more. Each category goes into its own folder (male/female subfolders included).

collisions.label: Export collisions when available
collisions.hint: .ybn/collision files are included if the source pipeline provides them.

status.missingGtav: Select your GTA V Legacy folder for vanilla sources.
status.pickOutput: Select an output root folder first.

validation.gtavBad: Invalid folder: GTA5.exe and update/x64 not found
